question.question: What happens immediately when shared deck empties, and how do bird substitutions work for forced non-bird discards versus explicit bird costs?

expected.expected_answer: Immediately shuffle discard into new deck. Bird can match non-bird including multiple matching-card costs; forced non-bird give/discard must include birds. Non-bird cannot substitute for explicit bird.

source_passages.quotation: - **Cards:** Birds substitute for any non-bird suit, even for multiple same-suit payments. **If prompted to give or discard cards of a non-bird suit, you must treat your birds as that suit**; the instruction determines how many cards to give or discard. **Only a bird card can pay an explicit bird-card requirement; fox, rabbit and mouse cards cannot pay it.** Draw from shared deck top; when deck empties, immediately shuffle discard into new deck. answer.ruling: When the shared deck empties, immediately shuffle the discard pile into a new deck.

Bird cards substitute for any non-bird suit, including for multiple payments of the same suit. When instructed to give or discard cards of a non-bird suit, treat birds as that suit; the instruction determines how many cards are given or discarded.
Only a bird card pays an explicit bird-card requirement; fox, rabbit, and mouse cards cannot pay it.
